firstSentence: Automate continuous IT governance posture scoring for Tier-1 Non-Banking Financial Companies, converting 120+ RBI Master Direction mandates into real-time telemetry dashboards.
heroImageAlt: RBI IT Governance Master Direction Automated Compliance Scoring Telemetry for Tier-1 NBFCs
paragraphs: Tier-1 Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs) in India face intense regulatory scrutiny under the RBI Master Direction on Information Technology Governance, Risk, Controls, and Business Continuity. Manual quarterly audit spreadsheets fail to reflect dynamic cloud configuration drift, unpatched perimeter vulnerabilities, and third-party vendor risks. When annual supervisory inspections occur, delayed compliance reporting results in severe supervisory flags and regulatory penalties.

Our sovereign governance telemetry engine continuously harvests configuration state, access logs, and operational health metrics across private cloud VPCs, core lending systems, and partner APIs. Ingress agents collect structured telemetry over secure mTLS 1.3 tunnels, mapping raw infrastructure states against all 120+ clauses of the RBI Master Direction. The engine executes inside an air-gapped analytics enclave, ensuring sensitive architecture topologies never leave the NBFC's perimeter.

The compliance state machine evaluates risk vectors through an automated multi-criteria decision matrix updated every 60 seconds. Configuration drift or unapproved administrative privilege escalation triggers automated remediation workflows that isolate compromised nodes within 1.5ms. A continuous Merkle DAG records every compliance check, establishing an immutable audit history that proves continuous adherence rather than point-in-time assertions.

Statutory reporting conforms directly to RBI Master Direction DOR.FIN.HREC.REC.No.45/03.10.119/2023-24. The dashboard automatically compiles board-ready quarterly cyber posture dossiers and supervisory inspection annexures with verifiable cryptographic audit trails, reducing compliance preparation overhead by 88.5%.

faqs.question: How does automated scoring differ from third-party annual security audits?
faqs.answer: Annual audits provide only a snapshot that quickly becomes obsolete. Our engine continuously verifies compliance every 60 seconds, detecting and fixing configuration drift before it triggers supervisory penalties.

faqs.question: Can the system assess third-party fintech and SaaS vendor risks?
faqs.answer: Yes. The platform includes vendor risk telemetry connectors that assess API security headers, data localization compliance, and uptime SLAs across all integrated fintech partners.

faqs.question: Does the platform generate reports formatted for direct RBI submission?
faqs.answer: Yes. The engine outputs certified PDF and XBRL-compatible supervisory dossiers structured exactly according to RBI reporting templates.
